wholePhysicalScope: The named park way and native Oda Castle story identity locate the original castle. The elevation survey anchors the surviving main enclosure rim and moat. The verified park photographs show the representative wooden crossings and monument.
lodDetails: Four levels keep the survey-aligned earthwork, east moat and visitor crossings.
limitations: The model describes the existing earthwork, moat and low park structures. The wider castle district and conjectural medieval superstructures are outside this model.
Wooden walkway width, small landscape details and seasonal water extent are representative. Ground elevations and bank alignment use the published GSI field.
